title: Character sheet
description: One character for roster import. Every key listed is required; empty string is allowed only where noted. Do not include strength, intelligence, luck, or role.

label.description: Single lowercase DNS label for the subname under ENS_LABEL.

display_name.description: Human-readable character name. Must not be derived from the DNS label.

look.description: Visible body, costume, silhouette. One sentence.

brief.description: One short lore line the fight can act on.

injury_places.description: JSON array of at least one place this character can be injured. Each item is descriptive text or a short label. Taken from roster issues #11, #12, and #13. Not the current damage.

injuries.description: JSON array of non-empty injury strings for damage the character is carrying now. Must be present; use "[]" when unhurt.

status.description: Must be present. New imports use "alive". "dead" is not selectable. "" is only for names written before alive was the default.

icon.description: HTTPS CDN URL, or "" when unset. Missing key is an error.
